title: "CUPID-SEQ Fig 5 FINAL"
output: html_notebook

The following script includes analysis for examining the amplification bias between EMP and CUPID-seq protocols.

Beverly Fu

```{r Standard Setup}
# Configure directories, load libraries and base functions
source(paste0(here::here(), "/0-config.R"))

directory = paste0(here(), "/3-figures/")

output <- setup_tables(paste0(here(), "/1-data/DADA2_HS/"), '/1-data/HS-sample-info.xlsx')
ps <- output$ps # phyloseq object
taxa_order <- output$taxa_order # ASV plot order
samdf <- output$samdf # sample information
samdf$Sample <- rownames(samdf)

total_reads <- as.data.frame(sample_sums(ps)) # get total number of reads
colnames(total_reads) <- "total_reads"
total_reads$Sample <- rownames(total_reads)

# Add read counts
samdf <- samdf %>%
  left_join(total_reads, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(total_reads = ifelse(is.na(total_reads), 0, total_reads))

rownames(samdf) <- samdf$Sample
samdf <- samdf %>% select(-Sample)

sample_data(ps) <- samdf # update sample_data of ps2plot

cutoff_SI <- 0.001 # Supplementary Info ASV cutoff_SI
cutoff_MT <- 0.01 # Main Text ASV cutoff_SI (to minimize legend)

#######################################################################
# Subset of matched EMP and CUPID-seq samples, rarefied to 10 K reads.
# Drop samples that don't pass both filters
#######################################################################

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(!Phase %in% c("L2", "L3")
                                 & !Well %in% c("F01", "H01", "H12"))

ps2plot <- rarefy_even_depth(ps2plot, sample.size = 10000, rngseed = 100,
                             replace = FALSE, trimOTUs = TRUE)

surviving_meta <- as(sample_data(ps2plot), "data.frame") %>%
  select(Subject, Well, PCR) %>%
  distinct()

valid_pairs <- surviving_meta %>%
  group_by(Subject, Well) %>%
  summarise(has_EMP = any(PCR == "EMP"), has_DIP = any(PCR == "DIP"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(has_EMP, has_DIP) %>%
  select(Subject, Well)

keep_samples <- as(sample_data(ps2plot), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  inner_join(valid_pairs, by = c("Subject", "Well")) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

ps_rarefied <- prune_samples(keep_samples, ps2plot)

```

#######################################
# Fig. 5A/2: Read quality and distribution
#######################################

```{r Fig 5A}

pos_cupid <- read.table(paste0(here(), "/1-data/Quality_analysis/position_quality_cupid.tsv"), col.names = c("file","position","q_sum","q_count"))
pos_emp   <- read.table(paste0(here(), "/1-data/Quality_analysis/position_quality_emp.tsv"), col.names = c("file","position","q_sum","q_count"))

# aggregate across files properly: sum of sums / sum of counts, not average of per-file means
pos_summary <- bind_rows(
  pos_cupid %>% group_by(position) %>% summarise(mean_Q = sum(q_sum)/sum(q_count)) %>% mutate(Group = "CUPID-seq"),
  pos_emp   %>% group_by(position) %>% summarise(mean_Q = sum(q_sum)/sum(q_count)) %>% mutate(Group = "EMP")
)

g <- ggplot(pos_summary, aes(x = position, y = mean_Q, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CUPID-seq" = "#FF0000", "EMP" = "#0000FF")) +
  labs(x = "Read position (bp)", y = "Mean Phred quality score") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),      # Remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())      # Remove minor grid lines

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5A.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 1.83, height = 1.83)

read_cupid <- read.table(paste0(here(), "/1-data/Quality_analysis/read_quality_cupid.tsv"), col.names = c("file", "MeanQ"))
read_emp   <- read.table(paste0(here(), "/1-data/Quality_analysis/read_quality_emp.tsv"), col.names = c("file", "MeanQ"))

read_quality_all <- bind_rows(
  read_cupid %>% mutate(Group = "CUPID-seq"),
  read_emp   %>% mutate(Group = "EMP")
)

# summary stats for the text
read_quality_all %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(MeanQ), sd = sd(MeanQ), median = median(MeanQ), n_reads = n())

g <- ggplot(read_quality_all, aes(x = MeanQ, fill = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("EMP" = "blue", "CUPID-seq" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EMP" = "blue", "CUPID-seq" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Mean Phred quality score per read", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),      # Remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())      # Remove minor grid lines

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5A-2.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf",  width = 1.83, height = 1.83)
```

#######################################
# Fig. 5C: Read distribution
# Fig. 5D: Evenness and Fig. 5E richness (calculated by downsampling to 10 K)
# Fig. 5F: Singletons
#######################################

```{r Fig 5C-5F}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(!Phase %in% c("L2", "L3") # only one plate of DIP
                                 & !Well %in% c("F01", "H01", "H12")) # remove blanks

safe_max <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

meta_df <- as(sample_data(ps2plot), "data.frame")
meta_df$SampleID <- rownames(meta_df)

safe_max <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

reads_df <- meta_df %>%
  group_by(Subject, Well) %>%
  mutate(EMP_reads = ifelse(PCR == "EMP", total_reads, NA),
         DIP_reads = ifelse(PCR == "DIP", total_reads, NA)) %>%
  select(Subject, Well, EMP_reads, DIP_reads) %>%
  summarise(EMP_reads = safe_max(EMP_reads),
            DIP_reads = safe_max(DIP_reads),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(EMP_reads), !is.na(DIP_reads))

reads_df %>%
  summarise(
    EMP_mean = mean(EMP_reads, na.rm = TRUE), EMP_sd = sd(EMP_reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    DIP_mean = mean(DIP_reads, na.rm = TRUE), DIP_sd = sd(DIP_reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

g <- ggplot(reads_df, aes(x = EMP_reads/1000, y = DIP_reads/1000)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.2, alpha = 1, fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = expression("EMP total reads (\u00D7" * 10^3 * ")"),
    y = expression("CUPID-seq total reads (\u00D7" * 10^3 * ")")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

g <- ggMarginal(g, type = "density", fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, size = 8)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5C.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)

ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps2plot, sample.size = 10000, rngseed = 100,
                             replace = FALSE, trimOTUs = TRUE)

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_rare), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_rare)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)

shannon_fn <- function(row) {
  p <- row[row > 0] / sum(row)
  if (length(p) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

diversity_from_matrix <- function(mat) {
  richness <- rowSums(mat > 0)
  shannon  <- apply(mat, 1, shannon_fn)
  evenness <- shannon / log(richness)
  evenness[richness <= 1] <- NA
  data.frame(SampleID = rownames(mat), Richness = richness,
             Shannon = shannon, Evenness = evenness)
}

div_full <- diversity_from_matrix(otu_mat) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_full"), -SampleID)

otu_nosingle <- otu_mat; otu_nosingle[otu_mat == 1] <- 0
div_nosingle <- diversity_from_matrix(otu_nosingle) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_noSingle"), -SampleID)

otu_nosingledouble <- otu_mat; otu_nosingledouble[otu_mat <= 2] <- 0
div_nosingledouble <- diversity_from_matrix(otu_nosingledouble) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_noSingleDouble"), -SampleID)

frac_rare <- function(row, thresh) {
  nz <- row[row > 0]
  if (length(nz) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(nz <= thresh)
}
rare_frac <- data.frame(
  SampleID         = rownames(otu_mat),
  pct_singleton    = apply(otu_mat, 1, frac_rare, thresh = 1) * 100,
  pct_le_doubleton = apply(otu_mat, 1, frac_rare, thresh = 2) * 100
)

richness_df <- div_full %>%
  left_join(div_nosingle, by = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(div_nosingledouble, by = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(rare_frac, by = "SampleID")

meta_df <- as(sample_data(ps_rare), "data.frame")
meta_df$SampleID <- rownames(meta_df)
richness_df <- dplyr::left_join(richness_df, meta_df, by = "SampleID")

value_cols <- c("Richness_full", "Shannon_full", "Evenness_full",
                "Richness_noSingle", "Shannon_noSingle", "Evenness_noSingle",
                "Richness_noSingleDouble", "Shannon_noSingleDouble", "Evenness_noSingleDouble",
                "pct_singleton", "pct_le_doubleton")

transposed_df <- richness_df %>%
  group_by(Subject, Well) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(value_cols),
                list(EMP = ~ifelse(PCR == "EMP", .x, NA),
                     DIP = ~ifelse(PCR == "DIP", .x, NA)),
                .names = "{.fn}_{.col}")) %>%
  select(Subject, Well, starts_with("EMP_"), starts_with("DIP_")) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), safe_max), .groups = "drop")

summary_stats <- transposed_df %>%
  summarise(
    EMP_n = sum(!is.na(EMP_Richness_full)), DIP_n = sum(!is.na(DIP_Richness_full)),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !c(EMP_n, DIP_n),
           list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  )

summary_stats %>% select(EMP_n, DIP_n, contains("Richness"), contains("Evenness"),
                         contains("pct_singleton"), contains("pct_le_doubleton"))

seq_lookup <- as.character(refseq(ps_rare))
stopifnot(all(taxa_names(ps_rare) %in% names(seq_lookup)))

edit_dist_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(otu_mat))) {
  sample_name <- rownames(otu_mat)[i]
  row <- otu_mat[i, ]
  nz <- row[row > 0]
  if (length(nz) < 2) next
  
  dominant_name <- names(nz)[which.max(nz)]
  dominant_seq  <- seq_lookup[[dominant_name]]
  
  cand_names <- names(nz)[nz >= 2 & nz <= 10 & names(nz) != dominant_name]
  if (length(cand_names) == 0) next
  
  cand_seqs <- seq_lookup[cand_names]
  dists <- adist(cand_seqs, dominant_seq)[, 1]
  
  edit_dist_results[[length(edit_dist_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    SampleID = sample_name,
    count = nz[cand_names],
    edit_dist_to_dominant = dists
  )
}

edit_dist_df <- bind_rows(edit_dist_results)
edit_dist_df <- left_join(edit_dist_df, meta_df, by = "SampleID")

edit_dist_df %>%
  group_by(PCR) %>%
  summarise(
    n_candidates = n(),
    pct_within_1nt = mean(edit_dist_to_dominant <= 1) * 100,
    pct_within_2nt = mean(edit_dist_to_dominant <= 2) * 100,
    pct_within_3nt = mean(edit_dist_to_dominant <= 3) * 100,
    median_dist    = median(edit_dist_to_dominant),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pairs <- meta_df %>%
  filter(PCR %in% c("EMP", "DIP")) %>%
  select(SampleID, Subject, Well, PCR) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = PCR, values_from = SampleID, id_cols = c(Subject, Well)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EMP), !is.na(DIP), EMP %in% rownames(otu_mat), DIP %in% rownames(otu_mat))

otu_full <- as(otu_table(ps2plot), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps2plot)) otu_full <- t(otu_full)

emp_samples_full <- meta_df$SampleID[meta_df$PCR == "EMP" & meta_df$SampleID %in% rownames(otu_full)]
emp_mat_full <- otu_full[emp_samples_full, , drop = FALSE]
asv_ever_in_emp_full <- colSums(emp_mat_full > 0) > 0
baseline_rate <- mean(asv_ever_in_emp_full) * 100

results <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  emp_h <- pairs$EMP[i]
  dip_h <- pairs$DIP[i]
  
  dip_row <- otu_mat[dip_h, ]
  emp_row <- otu_mat[emp_h, ]
  
  nz <- dip_row[dip_row > 0]
  cand <- names(nz)[nz >= 2 & nz <= 10 & emp_row[names(nz)] == 0]
  if (length(cand) == 0) next
  
  results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    pair = paste(pairs$Subject[i], pairs$Well[i]),
    asv = cand,
    count_in_dip = nz[cand],
    seen_in_any_emp = asv_ever_in_emp_full[cand]
  )
}

res_df <- bind_rows(results)

cat("Total 'DIP-extra' ASV instances checked:", nrow(res_df), "\n")
cat("Baseline rate (any ASV ever seen in EMP, full untrimmed universe):",
    round(baseline_rate, 1), "%\n")
cat("Observed rate (DIP-extra ASVs also seen in EMP elsewhere):",
    round(mean(res_df$seen_in_any_emp) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("Enrichment factor:", round(mean(res_df$seen_in_any_emp) / (baseline_rate/100), 2), "x\n")

n_asv_full <- ntaxa(ps2plot)
n_asv_rare <- ntaxa(ps_rare)
cat("ASVs before rarefaction:", n_asv_full, "\n")
cat("ASVs after rarefaction + trimOTUs:", n_asv_rare, "\n")
cat("ASVs dropped by trimOTUs:", n_asv_full - n_asv_rare, "\n")

trimmed_asvs <- setdiff(taxa_names(ps2plot), taxa_names(ps_rare))
cat("Of the", length(trimmed_asvs), "ASVs trimOTUs removed, % ever seen in EMP (full data):",
    round(mean(asv_ever_in_emp_full[trimmed_asvs]) * 100, 1), "%\n")

g <- ggplot(transposed_df %>% filter(!is.na(EMP_Richness_full), !is.na(DIP_Richness_full)),
            aes(x = EMP_Richness_full, y = DIP_Richness_full)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.2, fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Richness (EMP)", y = "Richness (CUPID-seq)") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
g <- ggMarginal(g, type = "density", fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, size = 8)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5D.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)

g <- ggplot(transposed_df %>% filter(!is.na(EMP_Evenness_full), !is.na(DIP_Evenness_full)),
            aes(x = EMP_Evenness_full, y = DIP_Evenness_full)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.2, fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.8)) +
  labs(x = "Evenness (EMP)", y = "Evenness (CUPID-seq)") +
  theme_bw() + theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
g <- ggMarginal(g, type = "density", fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, size = 8)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5E.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)

g <- ggplot(transposed_df %>% filter(!is.na(EMP_pct_singleton), !is.na(DIP_pct_singleton)),
            aes(x = EMP_pct_singleton, y = DIP_pct_singleton)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.2, fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "% singleton ASVs (EMP)", y = "% singleton ASVs (CUPID-seq)") +
  theme_bw() + theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

g <- ggMarginal(g, type = "density", fill = "#CCCCCC", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, size = 8)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5F.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)
```

#######################################
# Fig. 5G: ASV relative abundance of EMP vs CUPID-Seq
#######################################

```{r Fig 5G}

ps2plot <- ps_rarefied

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>%
  filter(Abundance > cutoff_SI)

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot)
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order)

safe_max <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

transposed_df <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Subject, Well, Feature) %>%
  mutate(EMP = ifelse(PCR == "EMP", ifelse(is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI,
                                           -3, log10(Abundance)), NA),
         DIP = ifelse(PCR == "DIP", ifelse(is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI,
                                           -3, log10(Abundance)), NA)) %>%
  select(Subject, Well, Feature, EMP, DIP) %>%
  summarise(
    EMP = safe_max(EMP),
    DIP = safe_max(DIP),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EMP), !is.na(DIP))  # belt-and-suspenders, should be redundant now

transposed_df <- merge(transposed_df, taxa_order, by = "Feature")

correlation_result <- transposed_df %>%
  summarize(
    cor_value = cor(EMP, DIP, method = "pearson"),
    p_value = cor.test(EMP, DIP, method = "pearson")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop")

correlation_result

r_str <- as.character(round(correlation_result$cor_value, 2))
p_str <- sprintf("%.2e", correlation_result$p_value)

lab <- bquote(italic(r) == .(r_str) ~ "," ~ italic(p) == .(p_str))

g <- ggplot(transposed_df, aes(x = EMP, y = DIP, fill = Color)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") +  
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.3) +  # Add y = x line
  annotate("text", x = -3, y = -0.25,
           label = deparse(lab), parse = TRUE,
           color = "red", size = 2, hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, -1, -2, -3, -4), limits = c(-3, 0)) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*"(EMP ASV rel. abund.)"), y = expression(log[10]*"(CUPID-seq ASV rel. abund.)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),      # Remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())     # Remove minor grid lines

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5G.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)

#### Exploring zero abundance ASVs

# --- per-ASV detection summary, by platform ---
feature_summary <- df2plot %>%
  group_by(Feature, PCR) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    pct_undetected = mean(is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI) * 100,
    mean_abundance_all = mean(ifelse(is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI, 0, Abundance)),
    mean_abundance_when_detected = mean(Abundance[!is.na(Abundance) & Abundance >= cutoff_SI]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

feature_summary_wide <- feature_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Feature,
    names_from = PCR,
    values_from = c(pct_undetected, mean_abundance_all, mean_abundance_when_detected)
  )

# classify each ASV by where it's actually detectable
feature_summary_wide <- feature_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(detection_class = case_when(
    pct_undetected_EMP == 100 & pct_undetected_DIP < 100 ~ "DIP-only (absent from EMP entirely)",
    pct_undetected_DIP == 100 & pct_undetected_EMP < 100 ~ "EMP-only (absent from DIP entirely)",
    pct_undetected_EMP < 100 & pct_undetected_DIP < 100  ~ "Detected in both",
    TRUE ~ "Undetected in both — investigate"
  ))

# how many ASVs fall into each category?
feature_summary_wide %>% count(detection_class)

# distribution of per-ASV detection rate, split by platform
feature_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_undetected, fill = PCR)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  labs(x = "% of matched samples where ASV is undetected (below cutoff)",
       y = "Number of ASVs", fill = "Platform") +
  theme_bw()

### 
temp_dip <- df2plot %>% filter((is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI) & PCR == "DIP")

temp_dip %>%
  left_join(feature_summary_wide %>% select(Feature, detection_class), by = "Feature") %>%
  count(detection_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

temp_emp <- df2plot %>% filter((is.na(Abundance) | Abundance < cutoff_SI) & PCR == "EMP")

temp_emp %>%
  left_join(feature_summary_wide %>% select(Feature, detection_class), by = "Feature") %>%
  count(detection_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

```

#######################################
# Fig. S2A: Calculating median fold change per family
#######################################

```{r Fig S2A}

ps2plot <- ps_rarefied

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>%
  filter(Abundance > cutoff_SI)

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot)
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order)

fold_changes <- df2plot %>%
  select(Subject, Well) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Subject, Well)

for (fam in unique(df2plot$Family2)) {
  transposed_df <- df2plot %>%
    filter(Family2 == fam) %>%
    group_by(Subject, Well, PCR) %>%
    summarise(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  transposed_df <- transposed_df %>%
    group_by(Subject, Well) %>%
    mutate(EMP = ifelse(PCR == "EMP", ifelse(is.na(Total_Abundance) | Total_Abundance < cutoff_SI,
                                             cutoff_SI, Total_Abundance), NA),
           DIP = ifelse(PCR == "DIP", ifelse(is.na(Total_Abundance) | Total_Abundance < cutoff_SI,
                                             cutoff_SI, Total_Abundance), NA)) %>%
    select(Subject, Well, EMP, DIP) %>%
    summarise(
      EMP = if (all(is.na(EMP))) NA_real_ else max(EMP, na.rm = TRUE),  # was max(..., na.rm=TRUE) alone
      DIP = if (all(is.na(DIP))) NA_real_ else max(DIP, na.rm = TRUE),  # was max(..., na.rm=TRUE) alone
      .groups = 'drop')
  
  transposed_df <- transposed_df %>% mutate(!!fam := DIP / EMP)
  transposed_df <- transposed_df %>%
    mutate(!!fam := if_else(EMP != cutoff_SI & DIP != cutoff_SI, !!sym(fam), NA_real_))
  
  fold_changes = merge(fold_changes, transposed_df[, c("Subject", "Well", fam)],, by = c("Subject", "Well"))
}
fold_changes_long <- fold_changes %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Subject, Well),  # all columns except Subject and Well
               names_to = "Family",       # column to hold the original column names
               values_to = "Value")       # column to hold the values

fold_changes_long <- merge(fold_changes_long, unique(taxa_order %>% select("Family2", "Color")), by.x = "Family", by.y = "Family2")

# Compute median per Family
medians <- fold_changes_long %>%
  group_by(Family, Color) %>%
  summarise(median_value = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE))

g <- ggplot(fold_changes_long, aes(x = Value, fill = Color)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 40, 80, 120, 160)) +
  facet_wrap(~Family, labeller = labeller(Family = function(x) gsub("^f__", "", x)), ncol = 7) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_vline(data = medians, aes(xintercept = median_value), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = medians,
            aes(x = median_value + 1, y = 100, label = paste0("med = ", round(median_value, 2))),
            color = "red", size = 2, hjust = 0) +
  labs(x = "Fold change of ASVs by family", y = "Counts") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 4),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),      # Remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())      # Remove minor grid lines

ggsave(paste0(directory, "FigS2/FigS2A.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5.8, height = 3)
```

```{r Fig 5H}

  left_join(medians, by = c("Family2" = "Family")) %>%

    Abundance
  ))
```

#######################################
# Fig. 5I: Bray-Curtis distance
#######################################

```{r Fig 5I}

ps2plot <- ps_rarefied

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>%
  filter(Abundance > cutoff_SI)

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))

set.seed(100) # Consistent pcoa
ps2ordinate <- ps2plot # Choose which samples you want to ordinate
otu_table_ps <- otu_table(ps2ordinate)

otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps[rowSums(otu_table_ps) > 0, ] # Remove rows with all zeros (empty OTU rows)
otu_table_ps_clean <- otu_table_ps_clean[rowSums(otu_table_ps_clean > 0) >= 3, ] # Remove OTUs present in < 3 samples

retained_otus <- taxa_names(otu_table_ps_clean)

# Subset all components accordingly
ps_clean <- merge_phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_table_ps_clean),
  sample_data(ps2plot),
  tax_table(ps2plot)[retained_otus, ],
  phy_tree(ps2plot)
)

ps_clean <- prune_taxa(retained_otus, ps_clean)

bc_dist <- phyloseq::distance(ps_clean, method = "bray")
bc_mat  <- as.matrix(bc_dist)

bc_long <- bc_mat %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample1, names_to = "sample2", values_to = "distance") %>%
  filter(sample1 < sample2)  # upper triangle only

samdf <- as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample")

meta1 <- samdf %>%
  rename(sample1 = Sample) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "1"), -sample1)

meta2 <- samdf %>%
  rename(sample2 = Sample) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "2"), -sample2)

bc_long_meta <- bc_long %>%
  left_join(meta1, by = "sample1") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample2")

bc_filtered <- bc_long_meta %>%
  filter( (Platform1 == "MiSeq"  & Platform2 == "NovaSeq") |
            (Platform1 == "NovaSeq" & Platform2 == "MiSeq")) %>%
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      Subject1 == Subject2 & Well1 == Well2 & Drug1 == Drug2,
      "Same", "Different"
    )
  )

g <- ggplot(bc_filtered, aes(x = distance, fill = label)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(label), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Same" = "#FF0000", "Different" = "#CCCCCC")) +
  labs(x = "Bray-Curtis distance", y = "Count", fill = "Comparison") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_custom_text() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),      # Remove major grid lines
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())      # Remove minor grid lines

ggsave(paste0(directory, "Fig5/Fig5I.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 2, height = 2)
```
